items.stem: When preparing a consolidated statement of financial position, how are intra-group balances such as a loan between parent and subsidiary treated?

options.text: They are eliminated in full on consolidation
options.rationale: Correct: intra-group balances are eliminated in full.

options.text: They are reported gross as external balances
options.rationale: Intra-group balances are eliminated, not shown as external.

options.text: They are recognised only as a note
options.rationale: They are eliminated from the figures, not merely noted.

options.text: They are added together and shown as goodwill

items.explanation: Correct: intra-group balances are eliminated in full.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO adjustments are required when a subsidiary is acquired part-way through the reporting year? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Only the post-acquisition results of the subsidiary are included in consolidated profit
options.rationale: Correct: results are included from the acquisition date onward.

options.text: The subsidiary's results are time-apportioned to the period after acquisition, assuming they arise evenly, unless indicated otherwise
options.rationale: Correct: post-acquisition results are time-apportioned where appropriate.

options.text: A full year of the subsidiary's profit is consolidated regardless of acquisition date
The subsidiary's pre-acquisition profit is added to group retained earnings
options.rationale: Pre-acquisition profit is not added to group retained earnings.

items.explanation: Correct: results are included from the acquisition date onward.
items.domain_ref: Consolidated statement of profit or loss

items.stem: A parent sells goods to its 80%-owned subsidiary at a profit, and some remain unsold in the subsidiary's inventory at year-end. Why must the unrealised profit be eliminated?

options.text: Profit is only realised to the group when goods are sold outside the group, so unrealised intra-group profit must be removed
options.rationale: Correct: unrealised profit on intra-group inventory is eliminated until sold externally.

options.text: Intra-group sales are illegal and must be reversed
options.rationale: Intra-group sales are not illegal; the issue is unrealised profit.

options.text: Only the subsidiary's own profit is ever eliminated
options.rationale: Unrealised profit is eliminated regardless of which entity made the sale.

options.text: The inventory must be written off entirely
options.rationale: Only the unrealised profit element is removed, not the whole inventory.

items.explanation: Correct: unrealised profit on intra-group inventory is eliminated until sold externally.
